title: Explain
description: Answers from what PrediGol already knows. No AI and nothing made up: if a piece of data is missing, I say so.
choose: What would you like to know?

parlay.probability: Why does my parlay's probability go down?

other.label: Another question
other.help: Is your question not here? Write to us and we'll consider it for the next ones.

source.market: according to the market, margin removed

reason.same_competition_day: they are from the same competition and day

part.no_value: the price does not pay enough for what it is worth
part.odds: a price outside the range it uses
part.market: a market it does not cover yet

say.has_pick_one: This match has one PrediGol pick: open it and tap «Why this pick?» to see why it was published.
say.has_pick_other: This match has {count} PrediGol picks: open any of them and tap «Why this pick?» to see why it was published.
say.pick_rule: PrediGol only publishes a pick when a bookmaker's price pays more than its forecast says that outcome is worth (that is «value») and the selection meets all its rules. If none does, it publishes nothing: it never makes up a pick to fill the space.
say.no_pick_published: PrediGol did not publish any pick for this match.
say.no_pick_past: A match that has started gets no new picks: they are chosen before kick-off, with the prices from before the match.
say.no_pick_no_forecast: There is no PrediGol forecast for this match yet, and without a forecast there is nothing to compare the prices with.
say.no_pick_no_prices: There are no recent prices for this match yet to compare with PrediGol's forecast.
say.no_pick_not_compared: PrediGol has not compared its forecast with this match's prices yet.
say.no_pick_not_published_one: PrediGol compared one selection of this match with the prices and it does not meet all its rules for publication yet.
say.no_pick_not_published_other: PrediGol compared {count} selections of this match with the prices and none meets all its rules for publication yet.
say.no_pick_no_value_one: PrediGol compared one selection of this match with today's prices and it does not meet its rules. Why: {parts}.
say.no_pick_no_value_other: PrediGol compared {count} selections of this match with today's prices and none meets its rules. Why: {parts}.
say.no_pick_may_change: Prices change until kick-off: if a selection comes to meet all the rules, the pick will appear on the match.
say.forecast_hidden: PrediGol is not showing its forecast for this match right now.
say.forecast_what: The forecast is the probability PrediGol works out for each outcome, with its models and the data from before the match.
say.forecast_market: {market}: the most likely is «{likely}» ({pct}{uncal}). The rest: {others}.
say.forecast_calibrated: «Calibrated» means those probabilities were checked against results: when PrediGol said 60 %, it happened about 6 times in 10.
say.forecast_uncalibrated: «Uncalibrated» means it is the model's own number, not yet checked against enough results: take it with more caution.
say.forecast_not_pick: A forecast is not a pick: the most likely outcome can pay little. There is only a pick when the price pays more than that outcome is worth.
say.risks_hidden: PrediGol is not showing this match's reading right now.
say.risks_intro: What could turn the match, according to PrediGol's data:
say.risks_none: I don't have data on this match's risks yet.
say.risks_incomplete: The reading is not complete yet (data are missing, such as the line-ups): it may change before the match.
say.pick_probability: PrediGol gives this selection a {pct} probability of winning: even with value, it does not always win.
say.pick_interval: Its estimate has a margin of doubt: between {low} and {high}.
say.pick_reading_hidden: PrediGol is not showing the match's reading right now, so there are no more risks to see here.
say.pick_started: The match has started: these are the data the pick was published with.
say.caution_downgraded: It is in caution because the context review found risks that weigh against it, even though the price still has value.
say.caution_none_approved: It is not in caution: the context review approved it.
say.caution_none_pending: It is not in caution: it is recommended for the value of its price, and the context review does not change any state yet.
say.caution_none_not_reviewed: It is not in caution: it has no context review yet, so it is recommended for the value of its price.
say.caution_no_value: It is not recommended now: at the best price available it no longer has value.
say.caution_rejected: It is not recommended: the context review found reasons against it.
say.caution_evaluation: It is a pick in evaluation, not a recommendation.
say.caution_what: «Caution» means PrediGol keeps the pick but warns you of a risk: you decide, with that information.
say.parlay_invalid: It cannot be worked out like this: the parlay breaks a rule.
say.parlay_single: With a single selection, the probability is that selection's.
say.parlay_all_win: A parlay only wins if all {legs} selections win: each one you add is another condition that has to be met.
say.parlay_leg_missing_one: I don't have the probability of selection {legs}: without it I cannot work out the parlay.
say.parlay_leg_missing_other: I don't have the probability of selections {legs}: without it I cannot work out the parlay.
say.parlay_dependency: Some selections are related ({reasons}), and PrediGol adjusts the calculation with what it measured: {pct}.
say.parlay_related: Some selections are related ({reasons}); PrediGol has no measure of how much, so it does not adjust the calculation: take it with more caution.
say.parlay_shrinks: That is why the probability goes down with each selection: even if each one is likely, all of them coming true at once is much less so.
say.parlay_very_unlikely: By the market's probabilities, margin removed, all of them winning is very unlikely: {pct}.
